name: Aoi Hinata
source:
Protagonist of Route A, a youth leaving his innocence behind.
2 years after the disappearance of his twin sister, Hinata leads a dull school life. Depressed and devoid of any goals, his life drastically changes after receiving a mysterious text message from his supposedly dead sister.
